text:
Steven Stamkos is 36 and has 12 goals in 24 games for a Nashville team that won eight of its last ten. The Hockey News headline put it bluntly: "Steven Stamkos on Pace to Demolish Franchise Record."

He's earning some of it. His chances (1.25 expected goals per 60) are at least as good as last season's, his one-timer still clocks in the 97th percentile for shot speed, and 13 of his 24 points have come on the power play. Our wins-added count, which weighs goals by how much they swung the game, ranks him eighth of 567 skaters: his goals have come when they mattered.

The finishing is the part to watch. He's shooting 21%, 2.7 goals above his chances, and that rate rarely holds across a season even for a shooter this good. Evolving-Hockey noted the opposite problem last year (more expected wins than actual), so the long view is a player whose luck has simply evened out.

At five on five, Nashville is outchanced with him on the ice (45% of expected goals). The goals are carrying a lot.
headline: Stamkos at 36, still beating the math
